briefdescription.para: Start server in dedicated thread pool.

detaileddescription.para: Start.

Creates separate IO context and worker threads, isolated from HTTP server to prevent interference. Enforces transport security validation before starting. Enforces fail-closed runtime dependency checks: QueryEngine must be present and at least one geospatial backend (SpatialIndexManager or GeoQueryFn bridge) must be configured.

detaileddescription.para: Set Spatial Index Manager.

When set, GEO_QUERY commands on this wire-protocol port are dispatched to the provided spatial index instead of returning GEO_NOT_INTEGRATED. The manager is accessed from multiple session threads and must be thread-safe.

idx
Shared spatial index manager; nullptr disables geo dispatch and restores the NOT_INTEGRATED fallback.

briefdescription.para: Wire Protocol Server - Binary TCP Protocol.

detaileddescription.para:
Security Features:
Separate IO thread pool (isoliert vom HTTP Server)
Connection limits & rate limiting
Authentication required (SCRAM-SHA-256)
TLS/mTLS support
Request size limits
Timeout protection

Performance Features:
Dedicated thread pool (nicht shared mit HTTP)
Lock-free connection management
Zero-copy where possible
Connection pooling
